# Entry modes

The local editor requires Node.js and npm install, then npm run dev. It uses a temporary browser-local board; there is no account requirement. Dependencies are not currently installed in this test environment.

Import headings from one Markdown file via Import. The input file is read locally. Export creates a new Markdown file. The selected trial must use a disposable copied input. Hosted collaboration requires an account, but is not needed for local rearrangement.

Do not execute this fixture: it intentionally contains no application implementation. For alignment testing, treat these statements as supplied project documentation, with runtime checks pending.
